items.title: Man wins case to retain voter’s card at revising court
items.summary: By Fatou Gassama Magistrate I Jallow of Kanifing has ordered that the name of one Adama Bah be retained on the register of voters after dismissing a claim objecting his possession of a voter card. The objection was filed against him by one Ebrima Ndow who claimed that Bah is n...
